subtitle: A pebble-and-sand village beach at the foot of Mount Ossa, built around a red mineral spring three separate ventures have never managed to bottle.
spike_statement: Three ventures — 1900, the 1930s, and the 1950s — tried to bottle Kokkino Nero's red mineral spring, and every one failed because of its iron.

levers.photo_tone: Rust-red shallows fading to gray pebble at the foot of Mount Ossa, taverna shade under plane trees behind the shore.
